title: Calendar
description: Appointments and events for your children at a glance.
empty: There are no appointments in the next 3 months.
responseRequiredSeries: Reply for every date in the series

answerScope.occurrenceHintOthers: The other dates of the series keep their reply.
answerScope.occurrenceHintOpen: The other dates of the series stay open.
answerScope.seriesHint: Your reply applies to every date in this series.
answerScope.seriesHintReplaces: Your reply then applies to every date, also those answered one by one.

noReminderDetail: You will not get a reminder for it.

responses.title: Replies
responses.privacy: You do not see other parents' names.

openEventTooltip: Shows or hides the details of this appointment.
acceptTooltip: Accepts right away. You can still change the answer later.
declineTooltip: Declines right away. You can still change the answer later.
previousMonthTooltip: Shows the appointments of the previous month.
nextMonthTooltip: Shows the appointments of the next month.
previousMonthBlocked: The calendar does not show past months.
nextMonthBlocked: The calendar does not show later months yet.
closeTooltip: Closes the details and shows the calendar again.
changeAnswerTooltip: Shows Accept and Decline again. Your answer stays until you choose again.
